source_documents_default_chk.name: source_documents_default_chk
source_documents_default_chk.value: not "source_documents"."is_default" or ("source_documents"."kind" = 'cv' and "source_documents"."language" is not null and "source_documents"."removed_at" is null)

source_documents_parsed_chk.name: source_documents_parsed_chk
source_documents_parsed_chk.value: ("source_documents"."parse_status" = 'parsed') = ("source_documents"."extracted_text" is not null and "source_documents"."kind" is not null)

work_experiences_dates_chk.name: work_experiences_dates_chk
work_experiences_dates_chk.value: "work_experiences"."end_date" is null or "work_experiences"."start_date" is null or "work_experiences"."end_date" >= "work_experiences"."start_date"
